levels.name: 第 0 关 · 发音入门
levels.desc: 48 个国际音标，掌握看词能读的拼读技巧

items.tip: 比中文"衣"更短更松，嘴角微咧
舌尖抵下齿，嘴半开，像快速说"诶"
嘴张大，下巴下拉，比 e 更开，美式经典音
嘴拢圆，短促发音，英式口音明显
嘴自然半开，像被轻拍肚子发出的"阿"
双唇微圆，短而松，不要拖成"乌"
最懒的音：舌身平放中央，轻而短，多出现在非重读音节
嘴角用力咧开，音拖长一拍，像微笑着说"衣——"
嘴张大，舌身放平后缩，音拖长

双唇收小圆孔，音拖长，像"乌——"
舌中部抬起，双唇微圆，英式经典长音

units.title: 双元音
units.desc: 8 个双元音，一气呵成的滑音

items.tip: 从 e 平滑滑向 ɪ，像"诶→衣"连读
从 a 滑向 ɪ，就是中文"爱"
从 ɔ 滑向 ɪ，如"哦一"连读
从 ə 滑向 ʊ，嘴由松到圆，像"欧"
从 a 滑向 ʊ，就是中文"傲"
从 ɪ 滑向 ə，英式卷舌明显
从 e 滑向 ə，如"哎尔"
从 ʊ 滑向 ə，如"乌尔"

units.title: 辅音 · 爆破音
units.desc: 6 个爆破音，3 组清浊对，气从口中"爆"出

items.tip: 双唇闭紧，气流冲开，声带不振动；放纸条会动
与 p 口型相同，但声带振动，摸喉咙有震感
舌尖抵上齿龈，气流弹出，声带不振动
与 t 口型相同，声带振动
舌根抵软腭，气流冲出，像轻轻咳嗽
与 k 口型相同，声带振动

units.title: 辅音 · 摩擦音
units.desc: 10 个摩擦音，气流从缝隙挤出

items.tip: 上齿轻咬下唇，吹气，声带不振动
同 f 口型，但声带振动；很多人口型错成"乌"
舌尖轻伸上下齿之间吹气，声带不振动；中文没有此音
同 θ 口型，声带振动，常见于 the/this/that
舌尖近上齿龈，气流细缝挤出，像蛇"嘶"
同 s 口型，声带振动，像蚊子"嗡"
双唇微翘，舌抬向上齿龈后部，像中文"嘘"
同 ʃ 口型，声带振动，较少见，如 television
像对着玻璃哈气，口型随后面元音变
舌尖卷起不碰任何地方，只从舌尖上方出气

units.desc: 12 个收尾辅音：破擦、鼻音、边音、半元音

items.tip: t 和 ʃ 连读，像中文"吃"
d 和 ʒ 连读，像中文"吉"

d 和 z 连读，像中文"滋"

d 快速卷向 r，像"捉"
双唇闭合，气流从鼻腔出
舌尖抵上齿龈，气流从鼻腔出
舌根抬起抵软腭，像中文"嗯"的后半
舌尖抵上齿龈，气流从舌两边出
双唇收圆快速滑向后面元音，像"乌"起手
舌面抬向硬腭快速滑出，像"衣"起手

levels.name: 第 1 关 · 零基础起步
levels.desc: 最常用的词与句型，能做简单自我介绍

units.title: be 动词与人称代词
units.desc: 英语第一课：am / is / are 怎么选

cards.explain: 第一人称单数 I（我）搭配 am；第二人称 you（你）和所有复数搭配 are。
第三人称单数（他/她/它）一律用 is。这是最容易考的点：见到 He、She、It 就选 is。
否定在 be 后加 not（is not → isn't）；疑问把 be 提到句首。

quiz.why: She 是第三人称单数，用 is。
第一人称 I 永远搭配 am。
you 搭配 are；疑问句把 are 提到句首。
They 是复数，用 are。
It 是第三人称单数，用 is。

items.ex: His sister is two years old.

items.exZh: 他们的女儿在伦敦读书。

items.ex: My desk is near the window.
I go to school by bus.

units.title: 疑问句型
units.desc: What / Where / Who 怎么问问题

cards.explain: What 问"什么"。结构：What + is/are + 主语。回答直接给内容。
Where 问"哪里"。最常用的两个：Where are you from?（你来自哪）Where do you live?（你住在哪）。
Who 问"谁"。Who + is + 人，回答用 He/She is …。

quiz.q: ___ is your name? — My name is Li.
quiz.why: 问"名字是什么"用 What。

quiz.q: ___ are you from? — I'm from Shanghai.
quiz.why: 问"来自哪里"用 Where。

quiz.q: ___ is that woman? — She is my aunt.
quiz.why: 问"那个人是谁"用 Who。

quiz.q: What ___ this in English? — It's a key.
quiz.why: this 是第三人称单数，用 is。
glasses（眼镜）是复数，用 are。

units.title: 情景对话 · 初次见面

lines.en: Hi! I'm Anna. What's your name?
lines.zh: 嗨！我是安娜。你叫什么名字？

lines.en: Hello, Anna. My name is Lin.
lines.zh: 你好，安娜。我的名字叫林。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Lin. Where are you from?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你，林。你来自哪里？

lines.en: I'm from China. And you?
lines.zh: 我来自中国。你呢？

lines.en: I'm from Canada. What do you do?
lines.zh: 我来自加拿大。你是做什么的？

lines.en: I'm a teacher. I teach math.
lines.zh: 我是一名老师，教数学。

lines.en: Great! Nice talking to you.
lines.zh: 太好了！很高兴和你聊天。

lines.en: Me too. See you later!
lines.zh: 我也是。回头见！

quiz.q: 问对方名字，Anna 说的是：
quiz.why: "What's your name?" 用于问名字。

quiz.q: "Nice to meet you" 的意思是：
quiz.why: 初次见面礼貌用语。
Lin 说 I'm a teacher. I teach math。
lately 常见告别语，"回头见"。

units.title: 写作 · 自我介绍

patterns.en: My name is ___, and I am from ___.
I want to learn English well, because ___.

example.en: My name is Lin, and I am from China. I am an engineer. I like music and basketball. I want to learn English well, because I need it for my job.
example.zh: 我叫林，来自中国。我是一名工程师。我喜欢音乐和篮球。我想学好英语，因为工作需要。

units.tip: 写 3～5 句即可。先套句型，再替换自己的信息。写完对照示例朗读一遍，检查 am/is/are 用对了没有。

units.title: 综合复习
units.desc: 从已学词汇自动抽题，全面检验第 1 关

levels.name: 第 2 关 · 日常场景
levels.desc: 吃穿住行全覆盖，能应对日常对话

units.title: 一般现在时
units.desc: 描述习惯与事实的第一时态

cards.explain: 主语是 He/She/It 时，动词加 s 或 es（like→likes, go→goes, watch→watches）。口诀：三单动词加 s。

examples.en: He goes to work at eight.

cards.explain: I/You/We/They + don't + 动词原形；He/She/It + doesn't + 动词原形（动词还原！）。
Do + you/we/they + 动词原形？ Does + he/she/it + 动词原形？

quiz.why: He 是三单，动词加 s。
doesn't 后面用动词原形。

quiz.q: ___ your sister work in a hospital?
quiz.why: your sister 是三单，用 Does。
主语 I 不是三单，动词用原形。

quiz.q: My parents ___ TV in the evening.
quiz.why: parents 是复数，动词用原形。

items.ex: I get up at six thirty.
I work from nine to five.
I sleep eight hours a night.
The kids play in the park.

units.title: 情态动词 can
units.desc: 表达能力与请求，人人爱用的 can

cards.explain: can 表示"会、能"，后面永远接动词原形，没有人称变化（不说 cans）。
can not → can't。表示"不会/不能"。
Can you + 动词原形 + 其他？日常请求万能句。

quiz.why: can 后接动词原形，且无三单变化。
前肯后否：会游泳但不会跳水。
Can you…? 是礼貌请求。

quiz.q: My grandma ___ use a smartphone now.
quiz.why: can 不随人称变化。

items.ex: We eat fish twice a week.

items.exZh: 苹果是我最喜欢的水果。

units.title: 情景对话 · 餐厅点餐

lines.en: Good evening! A table for two?
lines.zh: 晚上好！两位吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. By the window, if possible.
lines.zh: 好的。如果可以的话，靠窗的位子。

lines.en: Sure. Here are the menus. Can I get you something to drink first?
lines.zh: 没问题。这是菜单。先来点什么喝的吗？

lines.en: Two glasses of water, please. And could we order now?
lines.zh: 请先来两杯水。我们现在可以点餐吗？

lines.en: Of course. What would you like?
lines.zh: 当然可以。您想吃点什么？

lines.en: I'll have the chicken with rice, and a vegetable soup.
lines.zh: 我要鸡肉配米饭，再来一份蔬菜汤。

lines.en: Great choice. Anything for dessert?
lines.zh: 好选择。需要甜点吗？

lines.en: Not now, thank you. Maybe later.
lines.zh: 先不用，谢谢。也许一会儿再说。

quiz.q: "A table for two" 的意思是：
options: 两个人的桌子（两位用餐）
quiz.why: for + 人数 = 几位用餐。
I'll have… 是点餐常用礼貌句式。
dessert = 甜点。

items.ex: The bank is on your right.
How do I get to the station?
Is there a bank around here?
The shop is at the corner.
The hotel is near the sea.

units.title: 一般过去时
units.desc: 讲昨天的事，把动词换成"过去式"

cards.explain: play→played, watch→watched, work→worked。三单的 s 去掉再加 ed。

examples.en: I watched a movie last night.

cards.explain: 高频不规则：go→went, have→had, eat→ate, see→saw, do→did, buy→bought。

examples.en: We went to the park yesterday.

cards.explain: didn't + 动词原形；Did + 主语 + 动词原形？动词一律还原！

examples.en: I didn't go out last night.

quiz.why: go 的过去式是不规则 went。
规则动词加 ed。
didn't 后用动词原形 have。
过去时疑问用 Did，动词还原。

quiz.q: They ___ a new car last month.
quiz.why: buy 的过去式是 bought。

units.title: 阅读 · 我的一天
units.text: My name is David. I get up at six thirty every morning. First, I drink a glass of water and do some exercise. Then I have breakfast with my family. I go to work by bus, and it takes twenty minutes. I work in a small hospital. I am a nurse. At noon, I have lunch with my friends in the hospital. In the evening, I get home at six. After dinner, I read books or watch TV for one hour. I go to bed at ten. I like my life, because every day is different.
units.zh: 我叫大卫。我每天早上六点半起床。首先，我喝一杯水并做些运动。然后和家人一起吃早餐。我坐公交上班，路上要二十分钟。我在一家小医院工作，是一名护士。中午，我和朋友在医院吃午饭。傍晚六点到家。晚饭后，我看一小时书或电视。十点上床睡觉。我喜欢我的生活，因为每一天都不一样。

questions.q: What time does David get up?
questions.why: 文中说 I get up at six thirty。

questions.q: How does David go to work?
questions.why: 文中说 I go to work by bus。
文中说 I am a nurse。

questions.q: What does he do after dinner?
questions.why: 文中说 After dinner, I read books or watch TV。

questions.q: Why does David like his life?
questions.why: 文末说 because every day is different。

levels.name: 第 3 关 · 进阶表达
levels.desc: 谈计划、讲经历，写一封得体的邮件

units.title: 现在进行时与将来时
units.desc: 正在做什么 & 打算做什么

cards.explain: am/is/are + 动词 ing，表示此刻正在发生。
be going to + 动词原形，表示计划或打算，也用于有根据的预测。

examples.en: I am going to visit my uncle tomorrow.

cards.explain: will + 动词原形，表示将来的动作或临时决定。

examples.en: She will be here in five minutes.

quiz.why: Listen 提示正在发生，用现在进行时。

quiz.q: I ___ visit my grandparents this weekend.
quiz.why: be going to + 动词原形，表计划。
临时决定用 will + 动词原形。
Look! 提示正在进行。
客观事实既可用 will be 也可用 is going to be。

items.ex: I buy food at the supermarket.
We take a walk in the park.
There is a new cinema near here.
I study in the library on weekends.
The museum is free on Mondays.
The subway is crowded at 8 a.m.

units.title: 情态动词 must / should
units.desc: 必须做 & 建议做，语气大不同

cards.explain: must + 动词原形，语气最强：规定、义务。否定 mustn't = 禁止。
should + 动词原形，语气温和：建议、劝告。
must be + 名词/形容词 表示很有把握的推测："一定是"。

quiz.q: You ___ finish your homework before dinner. (妈妈的要求)
quiz.why: 强制要求用 must。

quiz.q: You ___ take a break. You look tired. (朋友建议)
quiz.why: 建议语气用 should。

quiz.q: The lights are off. They ___ be asleep.
quiz.why: must be 表示有把握的推测。

quiz.q: You ___ park here — it's not allowed.
quiz.why: mustn't = 禁止。

units.title: 现在完成时
units.desc: 经历与结果：have / has + 过去分词

cards.explain: have/has + 过去分词（done）。I/you/we/they 用 have；he/she/it 用 has。
already（已经）、yet（还）、just（刚刚）、ever（曾经）、never（从未）、for + 时间段、since + 起点。

examples.en: He has lived here for ten years.

cards.explain: have been to = 去过（已回来）；have gone to = 去了（还没回来）。高频考点！

examples.en: He has been to Paris twice.

quiz.why: already 是完成时标志词。
since + 时间点搭配完成时。

quiz.q: Tom isn't here. He ___ to the library.
quiz.why: 人不在 = has gone to（去了）。
ever 搭配完成时，eat 过去分词是 eaten。

quiz.q: We ___ each other for five years.
quiz.why: for + 时间段接完成时。

units.title: 情景对话 · 打电话约时间

lines.en: Hello, this is Lisa speaking. May I speak to Mr. Wang?
lines.zh: 你好，我是丽莎。请问王先生在吗？

lines.en: Hi Lisa, this is Wang speaking. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 你好丽莎，我是王。有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: I'm calling about our meeting. Would Thursday morning work for you?
lines.zh: 我打电话是想谈我们的会议。周四上午您方便吗？

lines.en: Let me check my schedule… I'm afraid I have another meeting at nine. How about ten thirty?
lines.zh: 我看一下日程……恐怕九点我另有会。十点半怎么样？

lines.en: Ten thirty is fine with me. Shall we say one hour?
lines.zh: 十点半没问题。我们定一小时可以吗？

lines.en: Sounds good. I'll send you a calendar invite after the call.
lines.zh: 可以。通话后我把日历邀请发给您。

lines.en: Perfect. Thank you, Mr. Wang. See you on Thursday.
lines.zh: 太好了，谢谢王先生。周四见。

quiz.why: 电话专用：This is … speaking。

quiz.q: "Would Thursday morning work for you?" 在问什么？
quiz.why: work for sb = 对某人可行/方便。

options: 委婉地拒绝/表达坏消息
quiz.why: I'm afraid 是礼貌的缓冲语。

units.title: 阅读 · 周末旅行
units.text: Last weekend, my friend and I took a short trip to Hangzhou. We left on Saturday morning and came back on Sunday evening. On the first day, we visited the West Lake. The weather was sunny, so we rented a small boat and rowed for an hour. In the afternoon, we walked along the old street and tried the famous local food. Everything was delicious, especially the fish. On Sunday, we got up early and climbed a hill to see the tea fields. It was tiring, but the view was worth it. We have already decided to go back next spring, because we heard the scenery is even better then.
units.zh: 上周末，我和朋友去杭州短途旅行。周六早上出发，周日晚上返回。第一天我们游览了西湖。天气晴朗，我们租了一条小船划了一个小时。下午，我们沿着老街散步，品尝了著名的当地美食，一切都很好吃，尤其是鱼。周日我们早起爬山看茶园。虽然累，但风景值得。我们已经决定明年春天再去，因为听说那时的风景更美。

questions.why: 文中说 came back on Sunday evening。

questions.q: What did they do at the West Lake?
questions.why: 文中说 rented a small boat。

questions.q: What was the best food for the writer?
questions.why: especially the fish 说明鱼最好吃。

questions.q: Why will they go back next spring?
questions.why: 文末说 the scenery is even better then。
tiring, but the view was worth it。

units.title: 写作 · 一封邮件

patterns.zh: 开头问候：希望一切顺利
patterns.en: I hope this email finds you well.
I look forward to your reply.

example.en:
Dear Mr. Smith,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to ask about the report deadline. Could you please confirm the date and format? I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Lin
example.zh:
尊敬的史密斯先生：

希望您一切顺利。我写信想询问报告的截止时间。您能确认一下日期和格式吗？期待您的回复。

此致
林

units.tip: 邮件三段式：问候 → 来意 → 收尾。套用 4 个句型，把任何主题替换进 to ___ 和 Could you please ___ 里，就是一封得体的英文邮件。

levels.name: 第 4 关 · 熟练运用
levels.desc: 从句、被动、职场与观点写作，听读写全面进阶

units.title: 被动语态
units.desc: be + 过去分词，重点换成承受者

cards.explain: be + 过去分词。时态变化体现在 be 上：is built（现在）/ was built（过去）/ has been built（完成）/ will be built（将来）。
① 不知道谁做的；② 做的人不重要；③ 强调承受者。科技、新闻里特别常见。

examples.zh: 我的手机昨天被偷了。（不知道是谁）

examples.en: The results will be announced soon.
examples.zh: 结果很快公布。（强调结果）

cards.explain: 需要说出动作执行者时加 by + 人。

examples.en: This song was written by Jay.

quiz.q: The window ___ by the boy yesterday.
quiz.why: 过去被动：was + 过去分词 broken。

quiz.q: Rice ___ in the south of China.
quiz.why: 米被种植 → 被动 is grown。
将来被动：will be built。
带 by 的过去被动 was written。

units.title: 定语从句
units.desc: 用 who / which / that 给名词加说明

cards.explain: The man who called you is my boss.（给你打电话的那个人是我老板）who 在从句里做主语。

examples.en: She is the teacher who helped me.
examples.zh: 她就是帮助过我的那位老师。

cards.explain: The book which/that I read is great.（我读的那本书很棒）which/that 做宾语时可省略。

examples.en: The phone that I bought last week works well.
examples.zh: 我上周买的手机很好用。

cards.explain: whose = 谁的。The girl whose father is a pilot…（那个爸爸是飞行员的女孩……）

examples.en: I met a man whose dog can sing.
examples.zh: 我遇到一个人，他的狗会唱歌。

quiz.q: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
quiz.why: 先行词是人，用 who。

quiz.q: I like the book ___ you gave me.
quiz.why: 先行词是物，用 which（做宾语也可省略/换 that）。

quiz.q: That is the boy ___ bike was stolen.
quiz.why: 后面是"自行车被偷"，表所属用 whose。

quiz.q: This is the house ___ I was born.
quiz.why: 出生"在房子里"表地点，用 where。

items.ex: We have a meeting at ten.
I need to finish the report today.
items.exZh: 我今天得完成这份报告。

items.exZh: 我来解释一下这个计划。

units.title: 阅读 · 新闻短讯
units.text: A new city library will be opened next month in the center of Riverside District. The building, which was designed by a famous local architect, has six floors and over 200,000 books. It was reported that the project cost 80 million yuan and took two years to complete. The library will be free for all citizens, and it will offer reading rooms, a children's area, and 24-hour self-service borrowing machines. "We hope the library will become a living room for the whole city," said the director at a press meeting on Monday. Computer classes for old people will also be given every Saturday morning.
units.zh: 一座新的市图书馆将于下个月在滨河区中心开放。该建筑由当地一位著名建筑师设计，共六层，藏书超过 20 万册。据报道，项目耗资 8000 万元，历时两年建成。图书馆将对全体市民免费开放，并提供阅览室、儿童区和 24 小时自助借还机。馆长在周一的新闻发布会上说："我们希望这座图书馆成为整个城市的客厅。"此外，每周六上午还将为老年人开设电脑课程。

options: In the center of Riverside District.
questions.why: 文中说 in the center of Riverside District。

questions.q: "a living room for the whole city" is ___
options: a real room in the library
a metaphor (比喻) for a comfortable public space
questions.why: 比喻：让市民像在家一样放松的公共空间。

units.title: 写作 · 表达观点

patterns.en: There are three reasons. First, ___. Second, ___. Finally, ___.
Some people say ___, but I think ___.

example.en: In my opinion, learning English is very useful. There are three reasons. First, English helps me read technical documents. Second, I can talk with people from other countries. Finally, it makes travel much easier. Some people say apps can translate everything, but I think real communication needs real language. In conclusion, English is a key skill for my future.
example.zh: 在我看来，学英语非常有用。原因有三点：第一，英语帮我读技术文档；第二，我能和其他国家的人交流；第三，它让旅行容易得多。有人说 App 能翻译一切，但我认为真正的交流需要真正的语言。总之，英语是我未来的关键技能。

units.tip: 观点文四步走：观点 → 理由 → 反驳 → 总结。用 First/Second/Finally 把理由排好队，逻辑立刻清晰。
